text:
Jules: Starting a co-marketing sprint with CometCloud — scope: joint webinar, short benchmark micro-post, and a co-authored how-to guide. Targets: 600 registrants, 150 MQLs, 30 qualified demos in 8 weeks.
Priya: Nice. Can we lock webinar date options? Comet suggested week of June 6. Two slots: Wed 7 @10am PT or Fri 9 @11am PT. Need final by EOD Wed.
Dan: Sales prefers Wed 7. Also request: include a "Book a demo" button on the post-webinar slide and the landing page.
Sofia: I'll own the content: benchmark micro-post + how-to outline. Need the eng-ml snippet: token-throughput and cost-per-1k tokens for Redwood routing vs Comet native for a 2k-seq model.
Jules: For tracking: landing form should include hidden fields: campaign=comet_launch, partner=cometcloud, utm_source=partner. Use one-click sign-up (email only) to maximize conversion.
Priya: For lead routing: rule set proposal -> 1) registrants -> queue/comet-launch 2) leads with Company_Size > 2000 or ARR_est > 2M -> flag for AE 3) others -> SDR nurture + in-product trial invite after 24h.
Dan: Can we auto-create Salesforce leads and set CampaignMember with campaignId=comet_launch_2026? LeadsBot?
LeadsBot: Zap test passed. Sample payload: {"email":"sam@widgetco.com","company":"WidgetCo","employees":"450","utm_source":"partner"} (sent to https://hooks.redwood.ai/partners).
Sofia: I'll draft the micro-post with two chart PNGs (latency vs cost, end-to-end demo time). PNGs for launch, we can add an interactive chart later.
Jules: Creative ask: 1 hero image (co-branded), 2 social card sizes, and 1 slide deck template for webinar. Who's on design? @growth?
Priya: growth said they can carve $2.5k for paid LinkedIn promos and account-based sponsored content. Growth: please confirm audience list by Tue.
growth: Confirmed budget. Send target ICP list CSV and we'll map to matched audiences.
Dan: SDR playbook: quick intro script, benchmarking one-pager, triage matrix (QL/QA), and demo calendar block links. I'll assemble and share by Mon.
Sofia: Legal asked for a one-paragraph co-branded statement and a GDPR data flow note. I'll draft both; need Comet legal to sign off.
Jules: Measurement: key metrics = registration -> attendance rate, MQL conversion, demo conversion, trial-to-paid within 60 days. Add tracking events: webinar_reg, webinar_attend, download_benchmark, demo_booked. Use GTM + partner utm.
Priya: A/B test idea for webinar CTA: "See the numbers" vs "See a live demo". We can route half the traffic to A and half to B and compare demo rate.
Dan: Good. Also add a post-webinar automated Slack notification to #sales-intel with lead summary top-10 by ARR.
LeadsBot: Prototype notification payload ready. Example: "New leads: 12 registrants, 4 high-priority (ARR>2M)."
Sofia: Timeline recap: Sofia -> micro-post + how-to outline by Fri. Dan -> SDR playbook + triage matrix by Mon. Priya -> confirm SF mapping, webhook, and target audience by Tue. Jules -> coordinate design and partner legal sign-off.
Jules: One more: partner enablement doc = 1-pager with talking points + 3 suggested customer stories. Comet wants 2 co-presenters: their PM + our solutions engineer.
Priya: I'll confirm Comet presenter names and avail windows.
Dan: For post-event nurture: 5-touch sequence (0d benchmark highlights, 2d how-to guide, 7d case study, 14d special trial offer, 21d last nudge). Include demo booking CTA in every email.
Sofia: Can we capture a micro-survey at registration: "Primary use case" with dropdown (Search, Assistants, RAG, Summarization)? That will help SDR qualification.
Jules: Yes — add that field. Make it optional to not hurt conversion.
Priya: Partner asked for a shared asset folder. I'll create a GDrive and invite Comet contacts after the MSA is countersigned. Link (internal): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/example_comet_assets
Dan: Anything else? Ops question: do we need to provision a dedicated demo instance for partner prospects? If yes, ping infra.
Jules: Good call. I'll open an infra ticket for a sandbox cluster for demo provisioning and tag it "comet-demo-sandbox".
Priya: OK — I'll follow up with Comet to confirm Wed 7. If they push, fallback Fri 9.
Sofia: Drafts incoming. I'll drop visuals and copy in this thread when ready.
Jules: Thanks team — weekly sync Fridays 9am PT until launch. :sparkles:
